description: A display holding as many labels as you add, for naming the inputs or channels of the module beside it; it comes up 10HP wide and resizes.
notes: the display holds no labels until you add one from the menu; a new label reads New Label.
a label is dragged up and down the display to the position you need.
the module is resized by dragging its top corners, from 5HP to 20HP.
right-click a label for its own menu: Label: for its text, Color: for its colour, Position:, Font Size:, then Left Align, Center Align, Right Align, Duplicate and Delete Label.
menu: Add Label — puts a new label on the display.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
